FlashRisk: This overwrites the selected partition. Confirm that the image matches this device and partition.
UnlockRisk: Unlocking performs a factory reset and erases your personal data. Continue and confirm on the phone?
UnlockUnavailable: The device does not report unlock permission.
FlashUnverified: Cannot verify that the bootloader is unlocked.
ClearCacheRisk: Clear cached files for the selected apps? Personal app data is kept.
CacheUnsupported: This Android version does not advertise cache-only clearing.
FlashLocked: The bootloader reports that it is locked.
FlashNoPartitions: No supported image partitions were reported by this device.
OdinHint: A Samsung phone is in Download Mode. Continue in Odin.
FastConsoleTarget: Select a Fastboot device to run this command.
BootInspectHint: Read values reported by the bootloader. Available values vary by device.
RestartPhoneRisk: The phone will restart and disconnect temporarily.
ShutdownPhoneRisk: The phone will turn off and disconnect. Use its power button to turn it back on.
WifiQrGuide: On your phone, open Wireless debugging > Pair device with QR code and scan this image.
WifiQrExpired: No phone found in two minutes. Check that both devices share a local network, then generate a new QR code.
WifiTimeout: The phone did not respond. Check the current IP and port in Wireless debugging and that the PC can reach the phone on this network.
ConnectGuide: If the phone is not listed, use the IP and port on the main Wireless debugging screen. This port can differ from the pairing port.
WifiGuide: Connect the phone and PC to the same Wi-Fi. On the phone, open Developer options > Wireless debugging > Pair device with pairing code. Copy the address and code from that dialog.
WifiPaired: Paired. If the phone is not listed yet, enter its connection address below.
WifiInvalidAddress: Enter the IP address and port shown on the phone.
ConsoleDesc: Run an ADB command, for example adb shell getprop ro.product.model.
MirrorHint: View and control the phone with your mouse and keyboard.
MirrorMissing: scrcpy is missing. Use the complete portable folder.
MirrorFailed: scrcpy could not show the device screen. Check USB debugging and the tool output.
PackageStillInstalled: Android still reports this package as installed after removal. You can try disabling it.
PackageUnconfirmed: Package state could not be confirmed. Reload the package list.
ChooseBackups: Choose the apps to restore. The latest backup is used for each app.
NoBackups: No backups yet. Apps backed up before uninstalling will appear here.
RestoreBackupRisk: Reinstall the backed-up APKs on the selected device?
UninstallRisk: APKs are saved in the Backups folder before removal from the main profile. Private app data is not included in the backup.
RiskLegendTitle: Risk of disabling or uninstalling an app
RiskMeaning1: Usually safe if you do not use its features
RiskMeaning3: Check which other apps depend on it first
RiskMeaning4: Do not disable or uninstall; system functions may stop working
AppReadError: Could not read applications. Select Scan again to retry.
AppScope: Main profile only. Disabled apps are included in the installed total. Removed apps cover packages Android still records for this profile. Sizes cover readable APK files only.
NoToolsHint: Use the complete portable folder with its bundled tools.
EmptyHint: Connect a USB data cable. For ADB, turn on USB debugging and authorize this computer on the device.
MultiHint: Select one device above to run commands.
InstallDesc: Select apps to manage or install APK files.
DebloatDesc: Disable or re-enable packages for Android user 0.
FastbootDesc: Inspect the bootloader and restart a device in Fastboot mode.
RecoveryDesc: Enter recovery or send an update package using ADB sideload.
TimedOut: {0} timed out. Check the device state before retrying.
WrongMode: The current device mode does not support this action.
TargetChanged: The device disconnected or changed mode. Scan again and check the target.
ToolFailed: Command failed. Check the tool output below.
InvalidFile: Choose an existing local file with the expected extension.
InvalidFolder: This folder contains neither adb.exe nor fastboot.exe.
PrefsFailed: Preferences could not be saved. Changes apply to this session.
ReadyHint: Use the menu on the left to manage this device.
AuthHint: Unlock the screen and accept the USB debugging prompt, then scan again.
OfflineHint: Reconnect the USB data cable, then scan again.
InstallHint: Choose a single .apk file. If the app is already installed, ADB will attempt an update.
NeedAdb: Requires an Android device with an authorized ADB connection.
LoadFirst: Load the package list from the active device.
BootHint: Enter from Android or an ADB-capable recovery. Read the product name once the target is detected in Fastboot.
RecoveryToolHint: Available when recovery exposes an ADB shell.
RecoveryHint: Enter from Android. In an ADB-capable recovery, you can also restart to the system.
StartSideloadHint: Switch recovery to sideload mode? If the device stays in recovery, select Apply update from ADB on the phone.
UpdateHint: Choose a ZIP. MasronDroid copies it into SideloadPackages before sending it. If recovery does not switch automatically, select Apply update from ADB on the phone.
InstallRisk: The APK will install a new app or update an existing one.
DisableRisk: Disabling a system package can disrupt Android. The package stays installed and can be re-enabled.
EnableRisk: This package will be re-enabled for user 0.
RebootRisk: The device will restart and the current connection will close.
SideloadRisk: Recovery will receive the ZIP and may apply a system update. Verify the model and file source before continuing.
CloseBusy: Wait for the command to finish before closing the app.
ScanError: Scan incomplete. Check the last result.
NoBoot: Select an Android, ADB recovery or Fastboot device to use its available controls.
NoRecovery: Use an Android ADB target to enter recovery. Select a sideload target to send a ZIP.
NoScanTools: Use the complete portable folder with its bundled tools.
MtpHint: Open Developer options on your phone and enable USB debugging. Unlock the screen and tap Allow when the USB debugging prompt appears.
MirrorTimeout: Screen startup timed out. Check the device and try again.
UnlockPhone: Select Show lock screen, then swipe and enter your PIN or pattern in the mirror. If Android hides the secure screen, unlock on the phone.
UpdateReady: Update ready. Close and reopen MasronDroid to apply it.
StayAwakeHint: Keep the phone awake while plugged in and mirroring.

BSOHHint: The phone reports BSOH of {0}, an estimate of battery health relative to its original capacity.
